headline: The attract screen now has a brain: the trained net plays Gauntlet for real
lede: Open Gauntlet and hands off: seat 2 belongs to plaicraft-bc/v1, the behaviour-cloning net from the PLAICRAFT pipeline. It walks, swings and survives the full quest beside the expert pilot across the held-out seeds 100..107 — the same eight boards it won 8/8 in research — closing each run with NET CLEARS THE QUEST!. The old planner-script replay survives only as the fallback if the model ever throws.

notes.text: #1641 shipped (PR #1647): a planner-free attract route in netdemo.js — live decisions from the BC net every tick, no plan() precompute, no script array. Held-out seeds cycle; the ticker only claims the brain while it actually drives.

netdemocheck (40 gates): all eight held-out seeds re-win through the shipped driver; dead weights diverge, so the seat provably steers; a throwing policy breaks the route sticky and the planner replay takes over. Mutant-proven: pin the net's forward bit and all eight win gates go red. First ciscope trip: a new alias must join a CI scope — netdemocheck now runs in the gauntlet scope.
Honesty glue rides along: a demo win banks no hi-score and never flips the screen (the old script replay could), and leaving attract drops the demo's BRAIN seat — the net is still opt-in with M.
Follow-up filed for the QA lane (#1655): point the camera at the net during the demo, stamp the seed on the win banner, and a demo-only win sting.
